original_question: Johnny ya karɓi alawans dinsa na $20 kuma ya ƙara ƙarin $10 a ciki. Sannan ya zuba wannan kudi a kasuwanci, wanda ya ninka sau uku a cikin shekara guda. Kudi nawa yake da shi bayan shekara daya?
